title: Add selectable coordinate source to panel route
description: Add a route and user-selectable coordinate annotation source so panel-coordinate generation can use the existing provider or UCSC, with documented source and assembly semantics.
acceptance_criteria: A route exposes coordinate-source selection; the selected provider is used for coordinate retrieval; defaults preserve existing behavior; focused validation covers both providers.
close_reason: Implemented Ensembl/UCSC coordinate-source selection with tested UCSC CLI route.
